Conformance against the vendormock mock (the mock token host verifies the RS256 assertion, the API accepts only the minted token). Landed as vendor audit events in namespace google.cloud_audit: the method through a closed 22-row table as the action (another method lands as other with a canary), principalEmail as the actor (a gserviceaccount.com principal is an agent), the resource name as the target, log type, service, status code and monitored resource type as detail. Synthetic only, no vendor response observed. assumption_tested: LogEntry and AuditLog are documented schemas without a cloudaicompanion example. Reach is pull_api: the cloud log is read through the Logging API, not a sink. Secret class reviewed: may_return_secret (request and response payloads can carry prompts and code); closed DTO, never decoded.
